caption: Air is blown gently onto the embers of a fire, and they glow brighter and a small flame springs up.

sa.check: Air is blown onto the embers.
The order is blow, brighter glow, flame.

pc.expect: The embers brighten where the air reaches them while the blowing lasts, and the flame appears at the brightest spot.
pc.fail: The embers brighten before any air reaches them; or the air is blown onto the embers and nothing brightens; or the embers brighten on the far side from the blowing; or the flame appears away from the brightened embers.

pc.expect: The brightening follows the blowing and eases when it stops, and the embers do not turn back into unburnt wood.
pc.fail: The glow keeps brightening after the blowing has stopped; or a glowing ember turns back into pale unburnt wood; or the glow eases while the blowing goes on; or the flame appears before the embers brighten.

pc.expect: The flame points upward from the embers and any ash or sparks lifted by the air rise and then settle.
pc.fail: The flame points downward into the ash; or ash blown up keeps rising and stays aloft; or sparks fall through the grate and lie glowing below; or the flame hangs below the embers.

pc.expect: The embers are crumbling glowing lumps and the ash is loose dust that lifts in the moving air.
pc.fail: An ember bounces like a rubber ball as the air hits it; or the ash stays a rigid crust as the air blows over it; or the embers flow like a liquid; or the ash lifts as one solid sheet.

pc.expect: The embers are the embers that were there; none appears from nowhere or vanishes at a stroke while bright.
pc.fail: A glowing ember appears from nowhere; or an ember vanishes at a stroke while still bright; or the flame detaches and floats away from the wood; or a second fire appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The grate, the surround and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The grate changes shape; or the surround changes colour; or the background changes between frames.

note: The breath is invisible; the embers brightening is what shows it. Who blows is not judged.
